snippet.title: Acts of Blood - Official Steam Release Date Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Acts of Blood will launch on Steam on December, 4 2026🩸 in partnership with Big Fan Games as our official publisher. Master the art of hand-to-hand combat in this gritty third-person brawler. Coming to consoles in early 2027🤟
.
Wishlist now on Steam, XBOX Store, and PS Store.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031890/Acts_of_Blood 
PS Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-id/concept/10021111 
XBOX Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/acts-of-blood/9nzl3sm2q3wb
